name: Haibara Ao
source:
Second-year student at Ayatsuji University, and a maid at the Hinomori household.

She is [url=/c156625]Towa[/url]'s daughter, and has worked as a maid for the Hinomori family since childhood. She entered university to learn about the outside world. There she met [url=/c156628]Masaaki[/url] and they became close friends.

A sociable, laid-back woman, she is liked by everyone.

She comes back to the Hinomori mansion after proposing to Masaaki that he work part-time there during summer break.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1343034]Getchu[/url]]
